**整个索引连数据一起删，不可恢复**。插件拒绝通配与 _all（那是删全集群）: **Deletes the entire index along with its data; this is unrecoverable**. The plugin rejects wildcards and _all (that would delete the whole cluster)
ES Query DSL 的 query 部分。**必填**：留空会被插件拒绝，: The query part of an ES Query DSL. **Required**: leaving it blank is rejected by the plugin — to empty the whole index, use "Delete index" and recreate it
ES Query DSL 的 query 部分，如 {\"bool\":{\"m: The query part of an ES Query DSL, e.g. {"bool":{"must":[{"match":{"message":"timeout"}}]}}; leave blank for everything
ES 应答 JSON，形状随接口而变，由官方文档定义: The ES response JSON, whose shape varies by endpoint as defined in the official docs
Kibana → Stack Management → API Keys 生成的: The encoded value generated in Kibana -> Stack Management -> API Keys. Set this and you don't need a username/password
Lucene 语法，如 status:error AND host:a1。与「查: Lucene syntax, e.g. status:error AND host:a1. Use either this or "Query" — if both are given, "Query" takes precedence
Lucene 语法；与「查询」二选一: Lucene syntax; use either this or "Query"
basic 认证；用 API Key 就留空: For basic auth; leave blank if using an API key
green 都好 / yellow 副本没分配（单节点常态）/ red **有主: green = all good / yellow = replicas unassigned (normal for a single node) / red = **a primary shard is missing, data is incomplete**
true = 实际命中**不止**这么多（ES 默认统计上限 10000）。要准: true = the actual number of hits is **more** than this (ES caps counting at 10,000 by default). Turn on "Exact total" for an accurate number
updated 改了 / noop 内容一样没动 / created 新建: updated = changed / noop = identical content, nothing changed / created = newly created
一次写入多篇（一个请求搞定，比逐条快一个量级）: Writes several documents at once (done in one request, an order of magnitude faster than one at a time)
写一篇文档；给 ID 就是覆盖写，不给 ID 由 ES 生成: Writes a document; giving an ID overwrites, otherwise ES generates one
分页用；ES 默认最多翻到第 10000 条: Used for pagination; ES pages up to item 10,000 by default
切换后别名指向的索引: The index the alias points to after switching
列出索引及其健康、文档数与占用空间: Lists indices along with their health, document count and storage size
删掉匹配的文档（清理过期数据常用）。**必须给查询**——不给等于删光索引: Deletes documents matching a query (commonly used to clean up expired data). **A query is required** — omitting it would delete the entire index
原始 _source，字段由索引里的文档决定: The raw _source; its fields are determined by the document in the index
取索引的 mapping（排查「为什么这个字段搜不到」的第一步）: Gets an index's mapping (the first step in debugging "why can't this field be searched")
只数不取文档，且**总数是精确的**（不受搜索那 10000 上限影响）: Counts without fetching documents, and **the total is exact** (not subject to the search 10,000 cap)
各索引的字段定义，键是索引名: Each index's field mappings, keyed by index name
后台跑时才有: Only present when run in the background
如 logs-*；留空 = 全部（不含系统索引）: E.g. logs-*; leave blank for all (excluding system indices)
字段:方向，如 @timestamp:desc。可给多个，先给的优先: field:direction, e.g. @timestamp:desc. Multiple can be given; earlier ones take priority
字段类型定义，如 {\"properties\":{\"title\":{\"t: The field type definitions, e.g. {"properties":{"title":{"type":"text"},"ts":{"type":"date"}}}; leave blank to let ES infer them from the first documents (dynamic mapping)
小写，不能含空格与大部分符号: Lowercase, no spaces or most symbols
局部更新：只改给出的字段，其余不动（写入文档是整篇覆盖）: Partial update: only the given fields are changed, the rest are left untouched (Index document overwrites the whole document)
建一个索引，可带 mapping 与 settings；已存在不是错误（crea: Creates an index, optionally with mappings and settings; it is not an error if it already exists (created=false)
必须是具体的一个名字，不接受 * 或 _all: Must be one specific name; * or _all are not accepted
把 ES 接进工作流：查日志与文档、灌数据、管索引。ES 7/8/9 与 Ope: Brings Elasticsearch into workflows: query logs and documents, load data, manage indices. Supports ES 7/8/9 and OpenSearch —
把一个索引的数据灌进另一个（改字段类型的唯一办法）。大索引建议关掉「等它跑完」拿: Copies data from one index into another (the only way to change a field type). For large indices, consider turning off "Run in background" to get a task ID instead
把别名原子地指向新索引（重建索引后的切换动作：查询方一直用别名，无感知）: Atomically points an alias at a new index (the cutover step after reindexing: callers that use the alias notice nothing)
按 ID 删一篇；文档本来就没有不是错误（deleted=false）: Deletes a document by ID; it is not an error if it did not exist (deleted=false)
按 ID 取一篇文档；不存在不是错误（found=false）: Gets a document by ID; it is not an error if it does not exist (found=false)
按 Query DSL 或 Lucene 简式检索文档，可带排序、分页与聚合: Searches documents with Query DSL or a Lucene query string, with optional sorting, pagination and aggregations
按字段排序时 ES 不算分，这里是 0: ES does not compute a score when sorting by field; this is 0 in that case
整批写完刷一次；默认关: Refreshes once after the whole batch is written; off by default
文档内容 JSON，字段名照索引 mapping: The document content as JSON, with field names matching the index mapping
文档内容（_source），字段由文档本身决定: The document content (_source); its fields are determined by the document itself
最多列前 10 条。**批量是部分成功的**：失败几条不会让整批回滚: Lists up to the first 10. **A bulk write can partially succeed**: a few failures do not roll back the whole batch
每个元素是一篇文档的 JSON: Each element is a document as JSON
留空 = 整个文档。字段多的索引里指定几个能省大量带宽: Leave blank for the whole document. Specifying a few fields in a wide index can save a lot of bandwidth
留空由 ES 生成 ID。**填上业务主键字段名就天然幂等**——重跑覆盖同一批: Leave blank to let ES generate the ID. **Setting this to your business primary key makes it naturally idempotent** — a rerun overwrites the same batch instead of producing duplicates
留空由 ES 生成。**给业务主键当 ID 就天然幂等**——重跑不会写出两条: Leave blank to let ES generate one. **Using your business primary key as the ID makes it naturally idempotent** — a rerun will not create a duplicate
直达任意 ES REST 接口（上面没覆盖的：_tasks、_ilm、_snap: Calls any ES REST endpoint directly (for anything not covered above: _tasks, _ilm, _snapshot, _sql etc.)
索引名或别名；多个用逗号分隔，支持通配（如 logs-2026.*）: Index name or alias; comma-separated for multiple, wildcards supported (e.g. logs-2026.*)
给已有索引**新增**字段定义。**已有字段的类型改不了**（ES 的硬限制，要: **Adds new** field mappings to an existing index. **The type of an existing field cannot be changed** (a hard limit of ES — to change it you must reindex and switch the alias)
聚合结果，形状由「聚合」定义决定: The aggregation results, whose shape is determined by the "Aggregations" definition
自建集群用自签证书时选 on（连接仍加密，但不校验对端身份）。默认 off: Choose on for a self-hosted cluster using a self-signed certificate (the connection is still encrypted, but the peer identity is not verified). Off by default
要先建好（带新的 mapping），否则字段类型还是让 ES 猜: Must already exist (with the new mapping), otherwise ES will still guess the field types
请求体 JSON，键名照 ES 官方文档；GET 也可以带体（ES 允许）: The request body as JSON, with key names following the official ES docs; GET requests may also carry a body (ES allows it)
连一下集群并报版本、发行版与健康状态: Connects to the cluster once and reports its version, distribution and health status
集群地址，如 https://es.internal:9200（带协议与端口）。: The cluster URL, e.g. https://es.internal:9200 (with scheme and port). For multiple nodes, any one of them will do
集群状态与分片情况（做巡检/告警的输入）: Cluster status and shard state (input for health checks/alerting)
默认 10。给了「聚合」而这里留空 = 只回聚合不回文档: Defaults to 10. If "Aggregations" is given and this is left blank, only aggregations are returned, no documents
默认关（ES 约 1 秒后自动可搜）。开了这条写入立刻能被搜到，但**每次都强制: Off by default (ES makes it searchable automatically after about 1 second). Turning this on makes this write searchable immediately, but **it forces a shard refresh every time, which is slow for bulk writes**
默认关：把别名从其它索引上摘掉，只指向新的。开了则是追加: Off by default: removes the alias from other indices so it only points to the new one. When on, it is added instead
默认关：文档不存在时报错: Off by default: errors if the document does not exist
默认只精确到 10000 条（超出回下界）。要准确总数就打开，大索引上更慢: By default only exact up to 10,000 (returns a lower bound beyond that). Turn this on for an accurate total, which is slower on large indices
默认同步等结果（超时会断，大索引慎用）。打开则立刻返回任务 id，用通用调用查: By default waits synchronously for the result (can time out, use caution on large indices). Turn this on to get a task ID back immediately, then check it with Generic call on /_tasks/<id>
